scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge from two days ago and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Brad Miller and I'm 34. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Brad, I'm sorry to hear you're seeing an unrecognized charge. I'd be happy to help you investigate this. To get started, could you please provide your account number and the last four digits of your social security number for verification?
Sure, my account number is 8829-4410 and the last four are 9982.

Thank you, Brad. I have verified your identity. I'm looking at your transaction history now. I see a charge for $76.00 on the 14th from 'Global Tech Solutions'. Does that name sound familiar, or is it definitely unrecognized?
No, I've never heard of Global Tech Solutions. I definitely didn't buy anything from them.

I understand. Per our Fraud Protection Policy, since you have confirmed this is unauthorized, I have initiated a formal dispute for this transaction. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity and have ordered a replacement card to be sent to your address on file.
Okay, that sounds like the right move. Will I get the $76 back now?

Under our billing dispute guidelines, I have issued a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours. The investigation team will finalize the dispute within 10 business days. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly with your case reference number.

resolution_summary: Agent verified the customer, confirmed the transaction was unauthorized, initiated a dispute, blocked the compromised card, and issued a provisional credit.
